cases.name: down_right_boundary_bellman
cases.explanation: At (3,2), down self-loops with probability .5 and right terminates with probability .5; V=-1+.5*gamma*V. The source greedy policy has expected 7.875 steps, not optimal 6.

cases.name: uniform_policy_bellman
cases.explanation: Gamma=0 sees only next reward. Absorbing uniform policy at gamma=1 has finite expected return; gamma=1 does not force every value infinite.

cases.explanation: Nine fixed seeds, each capped at 60; totals are undiscounted. Together with two shortest-path rollouts, exactly 20 small rollouts run.

cases.explanation: No probability normalization/nonnegativity/empty checks; evaluation also accepts total mass 2 or 0. Inclusive <= allows a zero-probability first action for random draw zero.
